title: Claremont Concerto
identity: John C. Worley, Claremont Concerto (1962), for alto saxophone and orchestra, with a piano reduction in the cataloged Presser edition 164-00254. UCL’s SaxOnline archive lists the three movement recordings, with tempo descriptions.

evidence.claim: Opened UCL archive page lists Claremont Concerto (1962), movements Allegro moderato, Adagio, Molto allegro, and separate MP3 links. The catalog identifies the Presser piano-reduction edition, but it was not examined.
The UCL page links MP3 tracks for each movement; links were not auditioned.

SaxOnline at University College London lists Claremont Concerto as a 1962 three-movement work and links separate Gwozdz audio tracks labeled Allegro moderato, Adagio, and Molto allegro. The recordings are linked but were not auditioned.
evidence.source_name: SaxOnline, University College London saxophone archive

review_focus: The UCL links were not auditioned and score notation remains unavailable.
collection_flag: Original concerto with orchestral and piano-reduction contexts; a performance recording lead exists.

listening.description: UCL SaxOnline page links recordings of all three movements.
listening.verification: Link presence verified on opened archive page; audio not auditioned.
